## Description {#details}

<p>C++ header file with declarations for the µTest++ value wrappers.</p>


<p>This header provides the declarations for the value wrapper types used within the µTest++ framework: the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">op</span> base struct, shared by all the framework expression types, the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">value_base</span> common base, the compile-time <span class="doxyComputerOutput">integral_constant</span> and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">floating_point_constant</span> types, created by the literals, the run-time <span class="doxyComputerOutput">value&lt;T&gt;</span> type, named by the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">to_*</span> and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">_*</span> aliases, and the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">named_bool</span> type, created by the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">_b</span> literal.</p>


<p>The wrappers carry the operands of the comparisons, so that the comparators can apply the type-specific rules (for example the precision of the floating point values) and the reporters can print the actual values.</p>


<p>All definitions reside within the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail">micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus::detail</a></span> namespace, since users name these types only through the literals and the aliases, never directly.</p>


<p>All header files are organised within the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus</span> folder to maintain a structured and modular codebase.</p>


<p>This file is intended for internal use within the framework and should not be included directly by user code.</p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Creates the compile-time constant of an integer literal.</p>


<p>The value is checked by <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/math/#a4f5af9be6a23a49f942e72de92adc91e">math::integer_magnitude()</a></span>, which accepts, for the signed types, the absolute value of the minimum; this value does not fit in <span class="doxyComputerOutput">T</span>, so it is represented by <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/integral-min-magnitude">integral_min_magnitude</a>&lt;T&gt;</span>.</p>
